entities.summary: Papyrus 119, designated by 𝔓119, is an early copy of a small part of the New Testament in Greek found among the Oxyrhynchus Papyri. It is a manuscript of the Gospel of John. Papyrus 119 is a manuscript. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
